tui_runtime_app_event_crashed: Sidebar event of the TUI after the subject service: it exited with an error. {code} is the exit code.
tui_runtime_app_event_degraded: Sidebar event of the TUI after the subject service: it answers but is not ready and has no note.
tui_runtime_app_event_done: Sidebar event of the TUI after the subject service: a one-shot finished well.
tui_runtime_app_event_failed: Sidebar event of the TUI after the subject service: it failed with no exit code.
tui_runtime_app_event_running: Sidebar event of the TUI after the subject service: it is up.
tui_runtime_app_event_stopped: Sidebar event of the TUI after the subject service: it stopped.
tui_runtime_app_event_unhealthy: Sidebar event of the TUI after the subject service: it stopped answering its health check and has no note.
tui_runtime_app_update_offer: Body of the TUI modal offering an update on exit. {version} is the new version.
tui_runtime_app_update_offer_runner: Same modal in a TUI attached to a runner. {command} is `atlas down && atlas dev --detach`.
tui_runtime_app_update_title: Title of the TUI modal offering an update on exit.
